claim: Primary X'70' is STE (Store, Short), RX format; short/long HFP register selectors are 0, 2, 4, or 6 and other selectors suppress the instruction with specification exception.

navigation.landmark: Floating-Point Instructions (Cont'd); Store, Short STE 70 RX R1,D2(X2,B2)

sources.title: IBM System/370 Principles of Operation, Seventh Edition
sources.evidence_note: Four floating-point registers are numbered 0,2,4,6. A short/long floating-point instruction selecting another register suppresses the operation and causes specification exception.
